programs.description: Mohanan finds healing in Ooty by adopting a baby after a heartbreak. Subsequently, he faces numerous dilemmas and challenges in his newfound role as a father.
Vinayan, a wealthy city-bred guy, moves to a village to lead a simple life. In a turn of events, he falls in love with a girl who wants the exact opposite.
Hyder Ali Hassan, a scheming politician, is in league with the underworld and runs a lot of illegal businesses. Balachandran, an IPS officer, is sent on a mission to capture him.
Bringing the best in television.
Young and pure of heart, Madhavan is adored by every single one of his villagers. However, a false accusation of two murders alters the course of his life.
After escaping his father's control, a man builds a new life only to be torn between loyalty and truth when his past and present dangerously collide.
Sultan, a labourer, tries to save his community from an evil bourgeoisie. He decides to take down their oppressors and help his people in leading a respectable life.
Unni, a bus owner, tries several ways to improve the condition of his bus, which is named after his late father. Things take a turn when the daughter of a powerful politician enters his life.

Balachandran comes under family pressure and marries Lekha. However, when he chooses to not have children, chaos ensues within his family.
June, a teenager, believes that there is nothing remarkable about her. She experiences adolescent crushes, handles heartbreaks and fights insecurities as she grows into a mature and confident woman.
When Alexander, a prominent leader, is falsely accused of murdering a CM, Danny, his nephew, navigates a web of political intrigue and danger to uncover the truth and prove Alexander's innocence.
Two carefree friends, Nithin and Anand, cross paths with the same woman, setting off a chain of misunderstandings that tests their bond and changes their lives.
Geetha's murder is pinned on Ramu, the man she rejected, while the real culprits, Johnny, Rahim, Swami and Kannan, get off scot-free. However, the four spoilt brats fail to elude their karma.

A greedy man tries every method possible to get rich and hoard more money. However, things take a turn when he accidentally gets his own son killed.
The prime minister of the nation gets killed and an efficient police officer, Sivaraman, gets appointed by the government to solve the murder mystery. He gets ninety days to accomplish the mission.
When Annie encounters her ex-lover, Tommy, after years, Tommy is oblivious to the fact that he is the father of Annie's child and Annie is unaware of the reason behind Tommy's betrayal in the past.
While driving in an inebriated state, Vishnu hits a man and kills him. When he tries to help the victim's family, he falls in love with his daughter but hides from her that he has killed her father.

A hard-working postwoman lives a contended life with her adopted son. However, her simple life is jeopardised after her beloved son is imprisoned under a false charge.
Revathy, a woman with special needs, falls in love with her rapist. When she tells her brother Mukesh to get her married to him, he initially agrees but later learns the truth.
After murdering Damodaran unknowingly, Viswanathan, a thug, tries to save his home from being sold. However, he falls in love with Damodaran's sister, Bhanu, who is unaware of his real identity.
Gopi, a pickpocket, comes across Savitri while trying to escape the police. However, days later, he is shocked to see her in a tight spot and tries to help her.
Two sisters-in-law, Maheswariyamma and Thankamani Kunjamma, compete fiercely to marry off their daughters to the wealthy Omanakuttan, but unexpected twists disrupt their plans.
Kunjulakshmi, pampered by her brothers, is somewhat arrogant. When she falsely accuses Sivashankaran, a peon, of misbehaving with her, he decides to teach her a lesson.

When his father asks him to manage their grocery store, Umesh runs away to Chennai to become a film-maker. His life changes after he takes a selfie with his old neighbour and posts it online.
Mathukutty and Kariya's families are well known rivals in a small village. Subsequently, a series of unexpected events follow when they both try to plot against each other.
Although married, Vishnu is a habitual flirt and always looks out for an affair. When he is almost caught with a young girl in his house, he lies to his family that she is his illegitimate daughter.
A thief and his family decide to mend their ways and start afresh, but things take a turn when they find themselves entangled in local issues.

Police officers Sudheendran, Balachandran and Jayadevan are tasked to find a culprit, who brutally murdered the family of IG Sekharan Thampi.
Sundaresan, a grocery store owner, marries an educated girl who gets a good job in another city soon after the wedding. Though he follows her to the new city, he plots so that she resigns.
Sherly, an orphan, falls in love with Roy not knowing that he is her financial supporter. However, Roy keeps his distance from her due to their age gap.
After Rugma's husband's untimely death, she struggles to raise her daughter as a single parent but does not get easily deterred by the challenges set before her.
Antony struggles against a myriad of challenges in life concerning his daughter and his friend serving as a police officer in their region.
After marriage, Sukumaran's wife Kanchana demands a glamorous lifestyle. However, Sukumaran, who finds it difficult to fulfil her wishes, takes a loan which he is later unable to repay.

Sachi and his girlfriend, Vasudha, go on a date to celebrate her birthday. Things go sideways, and their love is tested when they are harassed by two men on a late-night drive.
A man with average looks, lives an unconfident life and continuously suspects and spies on his attractive wife, until she resolves to leave him due to his nature.
A primary school teacher is obsessed with the world of cinema and dreams of becoming an actor one day. However, his blind obsession eventually leads him into a precarious situation.

Two rival family groups ask a mediator to choose who will run their upcoming religious event. However, the mediator uses this chance to uncover a hidden family secret.
Battling financial hardship, a lorry driver navigates life's obstacles as he strives to give his son the best education.

In an attempt to marry his beloved Anjali, Gopi dedicates himself to finding suitable matches for her unmarried sisters. However, one fateful night changes their lives forever when he accidentally commits a crime.
After getting married, Sunitha goes on her honeymoon, where she meets Hari, her professor. However, trouble ensues when Hari tries to uncover her husband's true identity.
A wealthy man gets rich through shady deals, not caring about ethics, but his world changes when he falls for a woman who is in another relationship.
Kalasadhan Ullas is an aspiring stage singer looking for his big break. However, his life is turned upside down when an opportunistic woman and her father target him for a nefarious purpose.

Two men, a writer and his friend, travel to an abandoned bungalow, unaware that it is haunted. However, when they reach, they meet a ghost who narrates his miserable life story to them.

An advocate disappears after his journalist-wife uncovers a shocking trail of corruption involving a powerful politician. When all hope seems lost, a stranger offers to help the couple secure justice.
Amudhavel, a simpleton, gets embroiled in the murder of Thamba, a local gangster. The police think that he is the culprit as he had a conflict with him in the past.
Diwakaran, a thief, steals jewellery from Aravindakshan, a school teacher. Jayashankar, a police officer who in reality is Diwakaran's brother-in-law, is appointed to investigate the case.

Hari is dejected when he learns that he cannot marry his lover until her elder sister is married off first. Desperate, he enlists the help of a marriage broker to find a suitable match.
Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.
After getting attacked by a gang of criminals, Sivan, a taxi driver, moves to an unfamiliar place. There, he meets new people who show him the true meaning of life.
Nandini is a bookworm who always wanted a writer for a husband. However, by binding her in marriage with a businessman, life teaches her that she may not always get what she wishes for.
When an honest doctor tries to stop a burglary, his entire family is killed. Balachandra, a fierce police officer, comes to his rescue and helps him fight for justice.
